item.title: Git Refs and Refspecs: Grammar Reference
item.author: technicalblog123@arran4.com (Arran Ubels)
item.description: Git’s ref system is a tiny language for naming objects and mapping them across repositories. This post is a grammar reference first, and examples second. Grammar reference Ref and refname 1ref := 'refs/' refpath 2refpath := name ('/' name)* 3name := 1+ valid-char 4valid-char := printable ASCII EXCEPT {space, control, '~', '^', ':', '?', '*', '[', '\\'} 5constraints := not (leading '/', trailing '/', '//', '..', '.lock', '@{') Common namespaces (grammar applies equally):
